title: Casper and the Choir
author: Xanthe Eriksen
blurb: Freya Pemberton, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
